services.name: Banana Boat Rides
services.desc: The journey begins in Harbour Town as you load up on the banana boat and steady yourself to be pulled by a high powered waverunner through the Calibogue Sound. You can expect to be splashed, sprayed and flung around as the banana boat is pulled through the Calibogue Sound. As you try to hold on, take in some of the best views Hilton Head Island has to offer. The banana boat is an exciting activity for kids and adults alike! We are passionate about providing our guests with a special and memorable experience while visiting Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. Our water activities and rentals at Harbour Town Marina provide a fun and convenient way to enjoy the coastal waters of Hilton Head

variants.label: Enjoy a Thrilling Banana Boat Ride in Hilton Head!

services.name: Guided Kayak Tour
services.desc: Imagine kayaking on the Calibogue Sound and in the surrounding marshes while the local wildlife is going about their day all around you. It is not uncommon to see dolphins swimming and playing close. Watch for herons, bald eagles, otters, sea turtles, and even the occasional manatee. During high-tide we can paddle through the scenic marsh which is close by. You will be transfixed by the natural beauty that surrounds you from a brand new vantage point. Our tour guides will narrate as you glide along the water, but feel free to ask any questions you may have during your tour. No experience is necessary for adults and children to thoroughly enjoy the Hilton Head kayaking experience at H2O

services.name: Guided Paddleboard Tour
services.desc: H2O Sports is thrilled to offer another great way to enjoy the local waters of Hilton Head Island. Stand-Up Paddleboarding, or SUP, is one of the fastest growing water activities and a great way to tour the island’s waterways. During your adventure, you will be learning about the local eco-system, observing the wildlife in its natural habitat, and experiencing the magical feeling of freedom on the water. It doesn’t get much better than this! SUP is easy to learn and fun for the whole family. You will learn the basics from our experienced instructors. quotes.author: Kirsten K. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: We had a great experience on the Alligator tour with Anthony. The boat was nice and quiet so we could enjoy the scenery. Anthony was very knowledgeable and helpful. We saw lots of alligators of all ages and sizes. And the preserve was beautiful. Great way to get away from the crowds and enjoy the wildlife.

quotes.author: P. J. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: We went for a dolphin tour with H2O sports. Had a great experience. We were just two families there. Small boat no crowd. Saw many dolphins got lucky I guess. Captain Freddy is very engaging fun and knowledgeable. Definitely recommend this for families.

quotes.author: Glenn B. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: Had an amazing day on the water with my wife, daughter and her boyfriend yesterday in Hilton Head. The staff is friendly and very professional. Great experience when vacationing in Hilton Head. I would recommend H2O Sports to all my friends and family.

quotes.author: Molly M. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Amazing time on our dolphin tour with Captain Freddy! So very knowledgeable, along with being very personable. We saw a ton of dolphins, as well as learned so very much about the area. Don't miss this experience with Captain Freddy; he is exceptional!

quotes.author: Ruthie T. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Awesome alligator tour in Sea Pines preserve. Anthony our tour guide was so knowledgeable and fun. Our family really enjoyed the tour, seeing the alligators and wildlife in the preserve. It was recommended by all my friends and did not disappoint.

quotes.author: Leigh P. • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Great time! Captain Mike was wonderful! Very knowledgeable and clearly loves what he does. Knew just where to look for the alligators. Provided lots of info on the native species. So glad we did this! Would definitely do it again.
